scope: official native vscandidate encoder/dense heads; scores and geometry separate; no labels/OCR/full acceptance
selection_metric: microF1=2*IoU>=0.5matches/(candidate+native counts), objects+text separatelymatched thenpooled; ties meanmatchedboxIoU, thenearliergridorder
reserved_policy: do not run candidate/native inference on reserved images until development-only policy selection is written and hashed; then evaluate selected policy and original pixel/noNMS baseline, no retuning
